title: The helical model - our solar system is a vortex
summary: An animation presenting a non-standard helical or vortex model of the solar system, in which the planets trail the Sun through space instead of orbiting in flat circles. The model is a non-conventional view that the author says differs from standard diagrams.
why: HN mostly cites it as the closest available visualization of the Earth's path through space, with caveats that it is exaggerated and inaccurate.
